blocks.orig: A mountain bike tour in Mto wa Mbu is a nice break in between safaris. The beautiful village close to Lake Manyara National Park is a green oasis in the surrounding Maasai plains, where rice, coffee and bananas can grow due to the presence of groundwater. The bike tour of 2 to 3 hours allows for some beautiful views of Lake Manyara as it takes you through the streets of the village, past the banana and coffee plantations and to a school.
blocks.html: Between safaris, a mountain bike tour in Mto wa Mbu makes a pleasant change. Close to Lake Manyara National Park, this lovely village is a green oasis among the Maasai plains, where groundwater allows rice, coffee and bananas to grow. During the 2 to 3 hour ride you get beautiful views of Lake Manyara as you cycle through the village streets, along banana and coffee plantations and on to a school.
